description: A section (mj-section); the top-level horizontal band that holds columns.

members.name: BackgroundColor
members.description: Gets or sets the background colour (background-color).

members.name: BackgroundPosition
members.description: Gets or sets the background position (background-position).

members.name: BackgroundRepeat
members.description: Gets or sets the background repeat (background-repeat).

members.name: BackgroundSize
members.description: Gets or sets the background size (background-size).

members.name: BackgroundUrl
members.description: Gets or sets the background image URL (background-url).

members.name: Border
members.description: Gets or sets the border shorthand (border).

members.name: BorderRadius
members.description: Gets or sets the border radius (border-radius).

members.name: Columns
members.description: Gets the columns contained in this section.

members.name: CssClass
members.description: Gets or sets the space-separated CSS class names (css-class).

members.name: Direction
members.description: Gets or sets the layout direction (direction).

members.name: ExtraAttributes
members.description: Gets or sets unmodelled attributes preserved for round-trip fidelity.

members.name: FullWidth
members.description: Gets or sets whether the section spans the full window width (full-width).

members.name: Id
members.description: Gets or sets the unique identifier of this section.

members.name: MjClasses
members.description: Gets or sets the referenced named MJML classes (mj-class).

members.name: Padding
members.description: Gets or sets the padding shorthand (padding).

members.name: TextAlign
members.description: Gets or sets the text alignment (text-align).
